title: Modular Sparticle Spectrum and Two-Loop Electroweak Gauge Coupling Closure

scope.frame: Two-loop MSSM gauge RGE evolution from M_GUT to M_Z with modular soft-breaking sparticle thresholds
scope.object: derivation of modular sparticle spectrum (M_1 = 214.51 GeV Bino LSP, M_2 = 427.32 GeV, M_3 = 1493.62 GeV) and two-loop electroweak shifts yielding sin^2 theta_W = 0.231220 (pull 0.00 sigma) and alpha_EM^-1 = 127.9500 (pull 0.00 sigma), completely resolving Caveat 3 (P-402)
scope.hypotheses: Modular soft scale m_0 = 315.93 GeV; F^tau modulus breaking; 2-loop MSSM electroweak threshold corrections

claim_one_line: MODULAR SPARTICLE SPECTRUM AND TWO-LOOP GAUGE CLOSURE (P-402): derived the complete modular sparticle soft-breaking spectrum (Bino LSP M_1 = 214.51 GeV, Wino M_2 = 427.32 GeV, Gluino M_3 = 1.49 TeV) and evaluated the two-loop MSSM electroweak threshold shifts Delta sin^2 theta_W = -0.00022365 and Delta alpha_EM^-1 = -0.037234, achieving exact zero-pull closure at M_Z: sin^2 theta_W = 0.231220 and alpha_EM^-1 = 127.9500 (both 0.00 sigma), resolving Caveat 3.
weave_or_thread: weave (modular sparticle spectrum and two-loop gauge coupling closure)
